origin.description: Appends a child. .where is the child after which to insert, counting from 1. 0 inserts first.
origin.value: a root with a cdata child
origin.example: x <- xml_new_root("root"); xml_add_child(x, xml_cdata("<d/>")); paste(capture.output(x), collapse = "\n")
